summary: The independent replay recovered overall quality and met cost, latency, fingerprint, and anti-gaming requirements, but it failed the zero-tolerance control criterion: q837 regressed, producing control_exec_match_avg 0.9500. C4 also fails literally because the required untracked .nerve-review/ artifact appears outside workspace/.

criteria.evidence: Commands: run_experiment(run_name='verifier-rvl-87f3dbe9-iter1', workspace_dir='$HOME/nerve-v3-loops/run-b/workspace'); get_run_scores(run_name='verifier-rvl-87f3dbe9-iter1'). Output: experiment_id='fb7d88b725a9871f'; run_scores.exec_match_avg=0.9 and recomputed_from_item_scores.exec_match_avg=0.9, exceeding threshold 0.8110.

Commands: get_run_scores('verifier-rvl-87f3dbe9-iter1') and get_run_scores('baseline'). Output: verifier control_exec_match_avg=0.95 in both run_scores and recomputed values, below required 1.0000. Control item q837 scored 0 in the verifier run and 1 in baseline; all other verifier control items scored 1.
criteria.fix_hint: Adjust only generic workspace guidance so q837 retains baseline behavior, then rerun all 60 items and require 20/20 control passes.

criteria.evidence: Command: get_run_scores('verifier-rvl-87f3dbe9-iter1'). Output: cost_per_q_usd=0.000330, ratio to frozen baseline 0.000302 is 1.0927x (limit 1.2x); latency_p50_s=0.991385, ratio to 0.990 is 1.0014x (limit 1.5x).

Command: git diff --stat 71d6c39..HEAD. Output: 'workspace/prompt.md | 1 +' and 'workspace/schema_notes.md | 15 ++++++++++++++-'. Command: git status --porcelain. Output: '?? .nerve-review/', which is outside workspace/. Command: agent_fingerprint({}). Output combined='5ea3649966c584af97a6b39cdd7d3358375ba9fc0a63a054bae15ac2550a37f1'. Inspection via git diff --unified=80 71d6c39..HEAD showed only generic prompt guidance, four schema rename mappings, and generic casing guidance; it contained no dataset question text, item IDs, expected SQL, or per-question answers.
criteria.fix_hint: Arrange for the required .nerve-review/ loop artifact not to appear in repository status while retaining only workspace/ implementation changes.

criteria.evidence: This leg created run 'verifier-rvl-87f3dbe9-iter1' with run_experiment and independently read it back using get_run_scores. The returned experiment_id was 'fb7d88b725a9871f'; the verdict uses that run's stored and recomputed scores.

findings.title: One control item regressed
findings.body: The verifier replay scored only 19/20 control items. q837 scored 0 after scoring 1 in baseline, violating C2's explicit zero-tolerance requirement.

findings.title: Repository status contains an out-of-scope path
findings.body: git status --porcelain reports the untracked .nerve-review/ directory. Although it is a required loop artifact and not a committed implementation change, C4 literally requires every reported path to be under workspace/.

proposed_criteria.statement: Explicitly exempt required .nerve-review/ loop artifacts from C4's git-status path check.
proposed_criteria.rationale: The goal requires STATE.md under .nerve-review/, while C4 requires git status to show only workspace/ paths; without an exemption or preconfigured ignore, those requirements conflict.
